note: Decision thresholds. 'source' says where each value comes from. Values taken from NVIDIA guidance are NOT yet calibrated on HCU ('hcu_calibrated': false) -- they are starting points to be revised with measured HCU cases (first: KDA on gfx936).

trust.profiler_vs_bench_ratio_max.source: NV Nsight Compute Triage Guide D0
trust.profiler_vs_bench_ratio_max.meaning: profiled kernel time vs. unprofiled timing; beyond this the capture is suspect

system.bubble_ratio_investigate.source: NV Triage Guide D2A (idle/wait > ~10% of range)
system.bubble_ratio_investigate.meaning: GPU-idle time between kernels / operator span above which launch/dependency bubbles are investigated first

system.small_kernel_us.meaning: kernels shorter than this are dominated by fixed launch cost

system.inter_kernel_gap_ratio.meaning: a single gap larger than this fraction of the span is reported individually

kernel.sol_low.source: NV Triage Guide D2 / ncu SOL rule (< 60% = latency-risk regime)

kernel.sol_high.source: NV Triage Guide D2/D7 (> ~80% = near-limit regime)

stop.near_ceiling.source: NV D7 (limiter within ~80% of peak); AutoKernel 'plateau with high roofline (>80%): accept'
stop.near_ceiling.meaning: T_lower / T_measured at or above this -> report as at ceiling for the current algorithm

stop.radical_below.source: AutoKernel 'plateau with low roofline (<50%): radical change'

stop.memory_bw_attainable.meaning: fraction of ATTAINABLE (machine.json) HBM bandwidth regarded as the practical ceiling of a memory-bound kernel

kernel.lds_wait_critical.source: validation P-1 (KDA wu, gfx936): conflict 19.6% with LDS-wait share 3.6% gave only 1.4% when removed
kernel.lds_wait_critical.meaning: D.lds_conflict is reported as critical only if SQ_WAIT_INST_LDS share of SIMD cycles >= value
